post1.quote: We want electric cars to cost half as much.

post2.quote: We back commercial deep-sea mining to expand mineral supplies

post3.quote: We’re aiming for electric cars at half today’s price.

paragraph.quote: We support commercial deep-sea mining as one avenue toward expanding the supply of battery minerals.

raw.note_quote: The claim that deep-sea mining will halve electric-car prices is not established. These drafts present halving prices as the organisation’s ambition rather than a guaranteed outcome.
